name: Vesicular-Vortex

civilization.name: Kethrim Ascendancy
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: The crust never rests here. Rivers of incandescent basalt vein the lowlands, ash climbs from vents along every fault, and beyond towering mountain ranges the sky stays the color of a bruise.
There is a hush that is not emptiness but attention, as if the landscape were listening back. Visitors report dreams of falling that persist for days after departure.
Nothing about the gravity well anomaly appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Whoever controls dark crystals controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
